name: Trauntal Camping
beschreibung: Trauntal Camping is located in Siegsdorf, Tirol, in a mountainous environment. The atmosphere at the site is quiet and allows for a stay in nature. From here, hiking trails and ski areas in the region are easily accessible. The campsite has sanitary facilities and pitches for tents as well as motorhomes. Guests have the opportunity to explore the surrounding Alpine landscape on foot or by bike. Nearby are villages with supply options. The site is suitable as a starting point for activities in the mountains.
